an ill woman fit to perform tasks? … Rather, … against … marital relations,

an ill woman fit to perform tasks? Since she is ill, she has no obligation to perform tasks and this is not deemed rebellious behavior. Rather, one must explain this as follows: If she rebelled against engaging in marital relations,

Rabbi Yehuda says: Seven terapa’ikin. Our Sages went back and were counted again, … they would make

Rabbi Yehuda says: Seven terapa’ikin. Our Sages went back and were counted again, meaning they voted and decided that instead of deducting a small amount from her marriage contract each week, they would make
announcements about her for four consecutive Shabbatot. And … that the court would send … to her
announcements about her for four consecutive Shabbatot. And they decided that the court would send messengers to her
Be aware that even if your marriage contract is worth ten thousand dinars, … you will lose … it is the same to me,

Be aware that even if your marriage contract is worth ten thousand dinars, you will lose it all if you continue your rebellion. If she does not retract her rebellion, she forfeits her entire marriage contract. With regard to this enactment, it is the same to me,
a betrothed woman or a married woman,

p: Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Yosef said to Shmuel:
Is a menstruating woman fit … conjugal relations?
Is a menstruating woman fit to engage in conjugal relations?
One who has bread in his basket,
is not comparable to one who does not have bread in his basket.
We make announcements about her only in synagogues and study halls,
The court sends … with her twice,
The court sends people to talk with her twice,
once before the announcement and once after the announcement.

p: That is not so. … there … was … heavenly assistance.
That is not so. That case should not serve as a precedent, as there the positive outcome was due to heavenly assistance.
the daughter-in-law of Rav Zevid rebelled … She was holding a certain garment
the daughter-in-law of Rav Zevid rebelled against her husband. She was holding a certain garment
and Rav Gamda was sitting with them.
Because Rav Zevid is a great man, … you … flatter him
Because Rav Zevid is a great man, are you willing to flatter him
and he did not resolve it?
